t: A Pi-sized Linux board with a 5 TOPS AI chip for camera projects.
steps: Buy the Alta from LoveRPi, the retailer Libre Computer lists.
Get a microSD card and a 5 volt USB-C supply that holds between 5.0 and 5.5 volts.
Download a Linux image from the Libre Computer hub page for Alta.
Write the image to the card with a card-flashing app on your computer.
Plug in Ethernet, an HDMI screen, and a keyboard, then power on.
Update the system and install Python.
Try a first AI example with the Mesa Teflon delegate for TensorFlow Lite.
Add a USB Wi-Fi dongle to go wireless.
